question: Where can I get the locations of electrical substations in Germany (transmission and distribution), with voltage level and operator?

answer.summary: OSM is the broadest tested national source for transmission and distribution locations, but only 16.25% of mapped substations have voltage and 33.49% have operator. Official national Basis-DLM geometry exists behind a paid licence, with free regional services, but its inclusion rule misses much distribution and it lacks these electrical attributes. JAO supplies official selected transmission names, voltage and asset owners; VDE and TSO maps supply geometry. No tested source answers the whole question completely.
main_caveats: Basis-DLM is a national official dataset, not a complete all-voltage registry: its substation land-use class follows recorded overhead lines and has no voltage/operator fields.
OSM counts are mapped objects, not a completeness estimate: 90,928/108,567 lack voltage and 72,208 lack operator; nodes, areas and multi-site relations need careful interpretation.
VDE is an association publication, not official operator data; it mixes existing and planned sites, has no voltage column and leaves Eigentum blank on 473/557 points.
JAO workbook has no coordinates. Its HTML substation markers are unlabelled; a transformer or line owner is not automatically the operator of every asset at a co-located station.
The research exceeded the 80-opening limit (117 reconstructed requests); remaining leads are explicitly unchecked. Distribution completeness and full official attribute coverage remain unresolved.
answer.confidence_reason: Live data tests and document examples support the partial answer. The opening limit was exceeded before it was noticed; national electrical-attribute completeness and several pending leads were not resolved.

how_to_use.example_request:
curl -sS --max-time 45 'https://ovp.dresel.systems/api/interpreter' --data-urlencode 'data=[out:json][timeout:25];nwr["power"="substation"](52.45,13.25,52.58,13.60);out center 3;'
Count request also executed: data=[out:json][timeout:25];nwr["power"="substation"](52.45,13.25,52.58,13.60);out count;
steps: The exact Berlin bounding-box query returned 1,193 objects (612 nodes, 580 ways, 1 relation); the sample returned three nodes.

For a national extraction the Geofabrik page exposes germany-latest.osm.pbf (4.5 GB). That bulk file was not downloaded because of the 100 MB trial limit. Country statistics were tested separately with Taginfo.
Retain object type, id, geometry and source timestamp. Interpret voltage as V and preserve multiple levels. Empty role/operator/voltage tags remain unknown.
Separate physical sites from several voltage buses and preserve lifecycle/type qualifiers; no completeness or operating-status filter was established for the whole country.
reading_traps: 108,567 country objects: 31,725 nodes, 76,802 ways and 40 relations. Of these 17,639 have voltage and 36,359 operator; 90,928 and 72,208 respectively lack these tags.

The current tested combinations endpoint gives 3,695 exact substation=distribution matches; the first card incorrectly used 4,832 (the all-tag value total, not its intersection with power=substation).

Geofabrik country extracts and their tag statistics are extraction regions; boundary objects and multipart geometry need a proper boundary check. Only three Berlin sample points were checked geographically and all fit the stated box.
A national PBF was not tested. The first card’s general claim that the main Overpass endpoint rejects automatic clients was not independently retested and is not inherited.
Geometry tagged exact means the mapped feature footprint, with no guaranteed survey accuracy; node/area duplicates or split sites are possible.

problems: Voltage and operator are optional and incomplete. Sample endpoint returned three Berlin nodes; national total is a separate tested Taginfo count, not an Overpass national query.

evidence.claim: Country total and element types were returned by Taginfo.
Regional combinations, not all objects carrying the other tag, determine attribute coverage.
Current extract date and large file size.
evidence.quote: contains all OSM data up to 2026-11-13T21:22:20Z. File size: 4.5 GB.

steps: National data access is paid/licensed and was not tested; the documented Shape mapping is SIE02_F, OBJART=41002, FKT=2540. These field names come from the opened official Shape specification, not a national content download.

NRW WFS requires a declared adv namespace in the XML filter. A CQL_FILTER trial was silently ignored (39,919 all industrial areas); the proper FES filter counted 858 substation polygons and the full response returned all 858.
The NRW sample is GML EPSG:4258 with latitude–longitude order; Brandenburg GeoJSON requested EPSG:4326 returns longitude–latitude. Do not swap them silently.

Brandenburg atkis_elektro contains other functions; restrict FKT=2540. Only this filtered class is counted as substations. The generic alkis_elektro electricity-building layer is not a verified substation inventory.
Diepholz layer11 and layer12 are separate voltage classes; the tested full queries returned 12 and 2 features. The API query with outSR=4326 provides x=longitude,y=latitude.
Preserve topographic inclusion scope and reference date; missing voltage/operator remain unknown.
reading_traps: National Basis-DLM is real and includes substations, but the full paid data were not downloaded; national counts and national coordinate quality were not measured.
The official national documentation says ±15 m for objects other than transport/water; the first card’s blanket ±3 m for all substation topography was too strong.
All 858 NRW polygons’ vertices fit lat 50.3726–52.4693, lon 5.9684–9.3934 (0 outside broad NRW envelope). This is a plausibility test, not an administrative-boundary audit.
All 14 Diepholz points fit the catalogue region lon7.74–9.6,lat52.37–53.11; the three Brandenburg polygons fit the state map envelope. These tests do not prove national completeness.
Brandenburg page attribution dates the topography 2020-04-20; the tested atkis_elektro sample is MODELLART=DLM50 despite the page’s ALKIS wording.
The older DKAN 110kV table is dated 2021-11-30, omits names in its displayed rows and differs from the current ArcGIS positions; it must not be silently merged.
No operator column exists in the tested regional geometry. Erfasser=Blömer in Diepholz identifies the recorder.

problems: The main national paid dataset was only inspected through product metadata and specifications, not acquired. Member counts are separate: NRW 858 polygons; Brandenburg 348 filtered polygons (sample3); Diepholz12+2 points.

steps: The tested825369-byte CSV contains7017 rows,802 with countryDE; parse with CSV rules rather than comma splitting.
Filter country=DE and retain bus_id,voltage,tags,x,y,under_construction,dc. All802 have numeric voltage and lie inside broad Germany envelope47.2–55.1N,5.8–15.1E.
The DE subset has744 distinct tags strings, not necessarily744 verified physical sites. Preserve bus aggregation rather than counting buses as substations.
No operator field is provided and no authoritative operator join was tested.
reading_traps: 802 rows are buses, not802 physical substations. There are467 rows at380kV,325 at220kV,7 at400kV and one each at320,450,525kV.
The radius500m aggregation changes the station unit and can combine nearby sites; the schema retains source ids but not a direct per-site operator field.
No110kV/MV/LV distribution rows. The academic processed voltage is not an official operator attribute.
Zenodo web fetch failed in one tool but default curl successfully opened record and CSV; this was an executor issue, not a source access restriction.

operators.note: Four control-area TSOs: 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT and TransnetBW; many distribution operators. BNetzA links an exportable MaStR Stromnetzbetreiber actor census. The tested VNBdigital directory contains 815 operators, which is a portal count rather than a statutory total.

publication_obligation.norm: EnWG §§14d,14e and §23c; Core Static Grid Model handbook cites Article 25(2)(f) Core DA CCM
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: §14d(4)(1) requires network maps including MV/LV substations and congestion regions; large DSOs submit plans, smaller DSOs transmit relevant data upstream under (9). §23c requires aggregate network statistics, not a point inventory. JAO publishes selected Core TSO electrical assets.
publication_obligation.frequency: DSO plans every two years by 31 October from 2026; regional scenarios ten months earlier. Core SGM every six months. §23c structural statistics annually by 1 April.

consolidated_republication.note: Consolidated publication exists for selected transmission electrical assets (JAO) and individual DSO reports (VNBdigital). This is not evidence of one complete all-voltage geospatial/electrical inventory.

checked_pages.saw: Collects DSO information; republishes conclusions as SMARD articles and directs individual plans to VNBdigital. The opened page did not provide a merged substation point layer.
Explains DSO planning, §14e joint platform and coverage of the 82 large obligated operators.
Portal and public GraphQL directory tested: 815 operators, 96 with activated nap service. Individual PDFs, not a tested combined point table.

checked_pages.organization: JAO on behalf of Core TSOs
checked_pages.saw: Joint Core SGM download, including all four German TSOs, but selected transmission assets and no coordinate columns in workbook.

national_registry.note: An official nationwide topographic dataset exists: BKG republishes Länder Basis-DLM. It includes substation land-use polygons (41002, FKT2540) along recorded overhead lines and omits voltage/operator. It is a partial national source, not a complete sector registry; the national paid data were not acquired.

checked_pages.saw: Opened nationwide product, paid licence/access conditions and official object catalogue: Umspannstation 2540 is explicitly present.
Registration help explicitly says substations are network infrastructure and are not registered as electricity consumption units.
GET encountered a Radware browser-verification page; a second ministry FAQ route also failed through web fetch. Ministry contents were not verified.
Opened joint operator page and followed JAO/individual static model publication; this page describes four control areas, not a unified all-voltage inventory.
The actual catalogue query returned 14 records: two Diepholz substation datasets plus planning documents/other topics. This query is not proof of national absence.

recipe: The demonstrated manual extraction is the Bochum2026 report: page3 identifies operator and13 existing HS/MS stations; Figures1/2 show HS/MS and MS/NS location dots. The PDF page was rendered and inspected.

Extract the project table on pages12–14 as named records, preserving the site label, voltage wording, proposed date and status; for example UW Linden and UW Berthastr. Preserve existing-equipment statements separately from future upgrades.

The tested extraction supports operator/tier and named project evidence. Unlabelled map dots cannot be reliably attached to table names from this report alone; a complete exact station table was not recovered.
For the opened UVP notice, retain project title, applicant,380kV description and named endpoint as document evidence. Approval date remains an approval date, not an energization date.
if_unstructured.location_method: The tested Bochum and UVP examples do not supply exact coordinates or cadastral references. Their maps/descriptions support only approximate/locality evidence. No method for obtaining the missing exact positions from further official annexes was completed before the research limit; the recipe does not infer them from service territories or connected lines.
cross_with: Opened official topographic services in source2 for independently published geometries; no automatic attribute transfer was validated.
Source4 JAO for specific published transmission asset names and voltage; co-location and ownership are not treated as proof of station operator.

open_questions: The VDE layer omits ownership on473/557 features and voltage throughout; the publication does not explain whether fuller releasable attributes exist. This requires publisher clarification.
The number and accuracy of unmapped distribution sites cannot be established from OSM counts, regional topography or one operator report; no authoritative national benchmark was obtained.
